Our Programmes

Three core curriculum areas, each designed to be meaningful in the local context where it is taught — with illustrations, activities, and examples drawn from children's own environments.

Waste & Recycling

Ages 6–16

Teaching children how to reduce, reuse, and take responsibility for the waste they create.

Learn more

Programme Materials

Water & Conservation

Ages 6–16

Helping children understand the value of water and how to protect it.

Learn more

Programme Materials

Energy & Climate

Ages 8–16

Empowering children to understand energy, climate change, and the choices that shape our future.
